# DataFilterExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Filter data by one or more numeric ranges.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/data-filter-extension",
  "type": "DataFilterExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/data-filter-extension').par.filterSize` (an input) and `op('/data-filter-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.filterSize`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `filterSize` | `NumberField` | `2` |
| `filterEnabled` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `filterRange` | `UnknownField` | `[[0,1],[0,1]]` |
| `filterSoftRange` | `UnknownField` | `null` |
| `filterTransformSize` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `filterTransformColor` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `getFilterValue` | `UnknownField` |  |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `extension` | `ExtensionField` |
